credited_prior_work.scope: The complete quadratic two-index formula, fixed-root characterization, structural dichotomy, and small-block individual-rank spectrum are prior results. The present package adds linear-family dimension bounds.

local_work: A seven-point full-rank binary subspace certificate proving the sharp dimension-six cap for F2-point ranks at most14 or12; an all-field geometric rank12 factor-locus proof with the same sharp bound; complete finite binary dimension-six classification and an explicit F4 scalar-extension counterexample.
field_and_hypotheses: The source is exactly R_(3,3) for all biforms of separate degree at most two. The rank14 upper bound concerns F2-linear spaces and all their F2 points. The rank12 geometric upper bound concerns any field and all vectors after extension to an algebraic closure; over infinite fields this follows from a cap on all field-valued points.
finite_evidence: Seven exact odd determinants of the literal integer0/1 source matrices; all511 nonzero binary source ranks; all43435 dimension-seven and788035 dimension-six binary spaces; explicit fixed-factor lower certificate; one F4 counterexample checked both over F4 and by binary restriction of scalars. The census is not a premise of either upper-bound proof.
prior_credit: Standard projective geometry retains its cited external attribution. The original source and individual-slice rank results retain their prior local credits. No historical-priority claim is made.
implementation_dependencies: The verifier reconstructs the literal source independently and imports no previous research implementation. No unmerged torsion package or theorem is required.
limitations: Bounds on linear families in one crossed source block, not a cap14 theorem over every field, a classification of geometric equality cases, a classification of all inclusion-maximal smaller binary spaces, compatible three-leg maps, or a matrix-multiplication exponent improvement.
